intro: Team Flare wants a beautiful world, and you're not in it!
Stylish, aren't I? Now battle!
player_won: How unfashionable...
Team Flare won't forget this!
player_lost: Team Flare stays stylish!

kalos_departure_from_unova: A letter arrives bearing the seal of the Kalos Pokémon Research Lab.
Professor Sycamore: 'I've followed your journey across Unova with great admiration.'
'In Kalos, we study a phenomenon called Mega Evolution — a bond so deep it transcends ordinary limits.'
'I believe you are exactly the trainer to unlock its secrets. Please, come to Kalos.'
Mom: 'I already packed! I found the most adorable house in Vaniville Town.'
Mom: 'And before you ask — yes, your Unova prize money paid for it.'
kalos_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}, welcome home! How's the journey going?
Mom: I used your Unova Champion earnings to buy this little place in Vaniville.
Mom: The neighbors are wonderful — full of young trainers just starting out.
Mom: Reminds me of when you were just beginning. Though you never stayed still long enough!
kalos_mom_home_2: Mom: Oh, {player_name}! I've been tending the garden out back.
Mom: You know, between Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, and Unova...
Mom: ...your prize money has bought me quite a collection of homes!
Mom: I'm practically a real estate mogul now. All thanks to you, dear.
kalos_mom_home_3: Mom: Vaniville is lovely this time of year. The flowers are incredible!
Mom: I heard you're chasing something called Mega Evolution.
Mom: Whatever it is, I'm sure you'll master it. You always do.
Mom: Come back soon. And keep sending those winnings home — I'm eyeing a place in Alola next!
kalos_sycamore_intro: Professor Sycamore: Ah, {player_name}! Welcome to Lumiose City — the heart of Kalos!
I study Pokémon Evolution, and the phenomenon I'm most fascinated by is Mega Evolution.
It's a temporary transformation powered by the bond between a trainer and their Pokémon.
To unlock it, you'll need a Mega Ring — and a trainer worthy of wielding one.
I think that might be you. But first — choose one of these three Pokémon as a partner!
kalos_sycamore_starters: Professor Sycamore: Chespin, Fennekin, and Froakie — each one special in its own way.
Your rivals have been eager to start their journeys too.
Here — take your chosen partner and a Pokédex.
Explore Kalos. Discover its secrets. And find what Mega Evolution truly means.
kalos_rival_vaniville: {rival_name}: {player_name}! Professor Sycamore said to meet here first.
I've been training already — can't waste a single day.
Let's battle! Right here, right now. Show me what you've got!
kalos_rival_won: {rival_name}: Hmph. You're already stronger than I expected.
Fine. I'll just have to work harder. I won't lose twice.
kalos_rival_lost: Don't get discouraged — we're just getting started.
kalos_shauna_intro: {friend_name}: Oh WOW! You must be {player_name}! I'm {friend_name}!
I'm SO excited to start our journey — I want to fill the Pokédex AND make tons of memories!
Let's be rivals! No wait — friends! No — both! Both is good!
kalos_tierno_intro: Tierno: Yo, {player_name}! I'm Tierno. I wanna make a Pokémon dance team!
Battle me sometime — I want to see if your Pokémon have rhythm!
kalos_korrina_mega: Korrina: You've earned the right to know the secret of Mega Evolution!
A trainer's bond with their Pokémon — when it reaches its peak — triggers this transformation.
Take this Mega Ring. With it, and a Mega Stone, your Pokémon can reach a power beyond imagining.
But remember — it only works if the bond is real. You can't fake that.
kalos_lysandre_intro: Lysandre: The world is beautiful. And beautiful things are worth preserving — at any cost.
Team Flare exists to create a world of everlasting beauty.
Those who cannot contribute to that beauty are... unnecessary.
I wonder, {player_name}, which side of that line you fall on.
kalos_lysandre_ultimate_weapon: Lysandre: The Ultimate Weapon will cleanse the world of those unworthy of its beauty.
Three thousand years ago, a king used it. The cost was everything he loved.
I am willing to pay that same price — and more.
Stand aside, or be swept away with the rest.
kalos_az_story: AZ: Three thousand years ago, I built the Ultimate Weapon to revive my beloved Pokémon.
But the weapon required life — I fed it the lives of countless Pokémon.
My Pokémon came back. But when it learned what I had done...
I have wandered too, for three thousand years, carrying the weight of what I did.
You... you who have the bond I destroyed... use it well.
kalos_xerneas_encounter: A brilliant blue light radiates from the depths of Pokémon Village...
The tree nearby trembles — and transforms.
Xerneas, the Life Pokémon, has awakened! Its horns shine with the light of life itself.
kalos_yveltal_encounter: Darkness gathers in the skies above the Pokémon Village...
Wings like twin blades tear through the clouds.
Yveltal, the Destruction Pokémon, descends! Its presence dims the light around you.
kalos_zygarde_encounter: The ground trembles in Terminus Cave...
Something ancient stirs in the darkness below.
Zygarde, the Order Pokémon, has appeared! It monitors the ecosystem's balance.
kalos_diantha_intro: Diantha: I've watched your journey through Kalos from afar.
It takes a rare kind of spirit to come this far.
I am Diantha — actress, and Champion of the Kalos Pokémon League.
Let me see the full picture of what you and your Pokémon have become.
kalos_diantha_won: Diantha: Magnificent. Truly, a performance worth remembering.
You've grasped something about battling — about Pokémon — that I spent years learning.
You are the new Champion of Kalos. Congratulations, {player_name}!
kalos_diantha_lost: Diantha: You have real talent. The script just needs another draft.
Come back when your story is ready for its final act.
kalos_departure_to_alola: Your Kalos Championship victory echoed across the world.
A week later, a golden envelope arrives — Alola Tourism Board letterhead.
'Congratulations, Champion! As a token of Alola's admiration, we present you with two first-class cruise tickets.'
'Professor Kukui is establishing Alola's first-ever Pokémon League. We'd be honored if you'd compete.'
Mom: Two tickets — one for you, one for me! I already have a bungalow near Iki Town.
Mom: The Kalos prize money went further than I expected in tropical real estate!
kalos_team_flare_grunt: Team Flare Grunt: Only beautiful things deserve to exist in this world!
Pokémon that don't serve Team Flare's vision are obsolete!
Step aside or be rendered unnecessary!
kalos_team_flare_lost: Team Flare Grunt: Tch. You may have power, but Lysandre's vision is inevitable.
kalos_malva_reveal: Malva: Surprised? One of your Elite Four was Team Flare all along.
I believed in Lysandre's vision — a beautiful world, preserved forever.
But you've shattered it. I... suppose I must accept that.
Come. Challenge me anyway. My Pokémon are still worth battling.
kalos_newgame_intro: Morning sunlight fills your new bedroom in Vaniville Town.
Mom: Rise and shine, {player_name}! The neighbors are waiting outside.
Mom: A letter came from Professor Sycamore in Lumiose City. It has your name on it!
kalos_newgame_professor: I study Mega Evolution, and I need young trainers to help me explore Kalos.
I've sent three Pokémon with this letter. Please choose your partner!
kalos_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Vaniville is so charming! I already love our little house.
Mom: If you send home prize money, I'll start a flower garden out back.
kalos_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Lumiose City has a café on every corner. Bring me a pastry someday!
Mom: And remember to rest. Even champions need naps.
kalos_mom_newstart_3: Mom: I used to race Rhyhorn when I was young, you know.
Mom: Your journey is your own race. Run it at your own pace!

intro: {rival_name}: Champion! I've been waiting for you here. One more battle, for real this time!
player_won: {rival_name}: You really are the Champion.
player_lost: {rival_name}: Keep at it, {player_name}.

intro: kalos_rival_vaniville
player_won: kalos_rival_won
player_lost: kalos_rival_lost

intro: {friend_name}: Let's try out our new partners! Ready?
player_won: {friend_name}: That was so fun!

intro: Viola: My lens is focused on you! A battle is just like photography — timing is everything!
player_won: Viola: Wonderful! You've earned the Bug Badge! Here, take this TM — Struggle Bug!
player_lost: Viola: The shot wasn't quite right. Come back when your timing improves!

requirements.fail_text: Viola is in the gym — challenge her when you're ready!

intro: Clemont: Science is amazing! But so is battling! The future is now, {player_name}!
player_won: Clemont: Incredible! My calculations were off! You've earned the Voltage Badge!
player_lost: Clemont: The science checks out — you need more training. Come back!

requirements.fail_text: Clemont's gym requires a special pass. Earn 4 badges first — his auto-lock system is no joke.

lines: Professor Sycamore: These Pokemon come from Kanto, far away.
Your partner and this one should get along. Take good care of it!

intro: Grant: I've scaled every peak in Kalos. Can you climb to my level?
player_won: Grant: You summit the challenge! Here is the Cliff Badge, and TM Rock Tomb.
Take this Jaw Fossil too. The fossil lab in Ambrette Town can revive it!
player_lost: Grant: The climb continues. Train harder and try again.

requirements.fail_text: Grant is climbing. Earn the Bug Badge first.

lines: Korrina skates up. 'You're the one Professor Sycamore told me about! Let's see your bond in battle!'

player_won: Korrina: Wow! Meet me at the Tower of Mastery. There's something you should see.

intro: Korrina: The Tower of Mastery has accepted you. Now prove your bond in battle!
player_won: Korrina: YES! You've done it! Take the Rumble Badge — and the Mega Ring! Mega Evolution awaits you!
Take this Sail Fossil too. The fossil lab in Ambrette Town can revive it!
player_lost: Korrina: Not yet! Train with your Pokémon more. The bond needs to be stronger!

requirements.fail_text: Korrina is at the Tower of Mastery. Earn the Cliff Badge first.

intro: Ramos: Yer roots run deep, do they? Let's see if they're deep enough for my Pokémon!
player_won: Ramos: Well, I'll be! You've grown into quite the trainer! Take the Plant Badge!
player_lost: Ramos: Yer still a seedling, sonny. Come back when you've grown a bit more.

requirements.fail_text: Ramos tends to his garden. Earn the Rumble Badge first.

intro: {rival_name}: Coumarine's Gym is next for both of us. Warm-up battle?
player_won: {rival_name}: You're getting stronger every time.
player_lost: {rival_name}: Keep at it, {player_name}.

intro: Valerie: Oh my... a visitor from another world? No — from another time, perhaps?
I am Valerie. I adore Pokémon so deeply I sometimes wish I were one myself.
player_won: Valerie: How... lovely. You have earned the Fairy Badge. Please take this TM — Dazzling Gleam!
player_lost: Valerie: My Fairy-types danced beautifully today. Come back when your steps are more graceful.

requirements.fail_text: Valerie awaits in her otherworldly gym. Earn the Voltage Badge first.

intro: Olympia: We have foreseen your arrival. The stars spoke your name.
Come — let us see if your future holds victory today.
player_won: Olympia: The stars do not lie. The Psychic Badge is yours. May your path remain clear.
player_lost: Olympia: The future shifted. Return — your destiny is not yet written.

requirements.fail_text: Olympia reads the stars. Earn the Fairy Badge first.

intro: {rival_name}: After everything with Team Flare... I need to know I'm strong enough. Battle me.
player_won: {rival_name}: Thank you. I feel ready now.
player_lost: {rival_name}: Keep at it, {player_name}.

intro: Wulfric: Brrr-illiant! You made it! The cold has a way of weeding out the weak!
Come then — let's see if you burn hot enough to melt my Ice-types!
player_won: Wulfric: Ha! You were burning bright! Take the Iceberg Badge — and head to Victory Road!
player_lost: Wulfric: Too cold for you! Train harder and return when you're fired up enough!

requirements.fail_text: Wulfric waits inside. Earn the Psychic Badge first.

intro: Malva: I had hoped never to see a challenger make it this far.
My flames will reduce your hopes to ash. Come.
player_won: Malva: ...Tch. You've beaten me. Even if I am Team Flare — I won't deny that.
player_lost: Malva: Reduced to cinders. As expected.

intro: Siebold: Ah, a challenger. Like preparing a new dish — I shall taste your strength.
Water is the essence of life. Today it is the essence of your defeat.
player_won: Siebold: A flawless recipe. I have nothing but respect.
player_lost: Siebold: The dish was lacking. More seasoning — more training.

intro: Wikstrom: Ha! A challenger of some renown! My steel is untarnished — can you scratch it?
player_won: Wikstrom: By the ancient code of chivalry — you have bested me honorably!
player_lost: Wikstrom: Your armor has holes! Forge yourself stronger and return!

intro: Drasna: Oh my, you've come so far! How delightful! My Dragons love a good challenge!
player_won: Drasna: Oh my... you've done it! How wonderful! Go on — the Champion awaits!
player_lost: Drasna: Oh dear! Don't be discouraged, dearie. Try again soon!

intro: Diantha: I've watched your journey through Kalos from afar.
It takes a rare kind of spirit to come this far.
I am Diantha — actress, and Champion of the Kalos Pokémon League.
Let me see the full picture of what you and your Pokémon have become.
player_won: Diantha: Magnificent. Truly, a performance worth remembering.
You've grasped something about battling — about Pokémon — that I spent years learning.
You are the new Champion of Kalos. Congratulations, {player_name}!
player_lost: Diantha: You have real talent. The script just needs another draft.
Come back when your story is ready for its final act.

intro: Team Flare owns these fossils!
player_won: How uncouth!
player_lost: Style is power!

lines: A Hiker is digging near the cave wall. "Found another one! I've got plenty."
"Take this Old Amber. The lab in Ambrette Town can bring it back to life."

intro: {rival_name}: So you made it to the Tower of Mastery too. Let's see whose bond is stronger!
player_won: {rival_name}: Your Pokémon really trust you.
player_lost: {rival_name}: Keep at it, {player_name}.

intro: You dare intrude on Lord Lysandre's plan?!
player_won: The beautiful world... slipping away...
player_lost: Beauty and power are one!

intro: Lysandre: The world is finite. What exists must be preserved — by eliminating excess.
player_won: Lysandre: ...A worthy beauty. I underestimated what you and your Pokémon represent.
player_lost: Lysandre: This is the only logical conclusion. A beautiful world cannot sustain everyone.

intro: This factory produces only for Team Flare!
player_won: Our style cannot be beaten by force...
player_lost: Fashion IS force!

intro: Celosia: You won't leave here with Team Flare's resources!
player_won: Celosia: How... unfashionable.
player_lost: Celosia: Impeccably done!

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours across the floor...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

intro: Mable: You're interfering with Team Flare's beautiful plans!
player_won: Mable: You'll regret crossing Team Flare!
player_lost: Mable: Everything proceeds according to Lord Lysandre's vision.

intro: {rival_name}: {player_name}. This is it. The last time we meet before the League.
Show me everything.
player_won: {rival_name}: ...Amazing. Go, {player_name}. Be Champion.
player_lost: {rival_name}: I've grown so much. Now — go. Win the whole thing.

intro: Tierno: Let's dance... I mean battle!
player_won: Tierno: Your moves are so smooth!

intro: Tierno: Rematch! My Corphish has new moves!
player_won: Tierno: Still the best dancer around!

intro: Trevor: Um... could we battle? For my Pokédex research?
player_won: Trevor: I learned a lot. Thank you!

intro: {rival_name}: My partner just evolved! Let me show you!
player_won: {rival_name}: ...I'll keep training.
player_lost: {rival_name}: Keep at it, {player_name}.

intro: {friend_name}: We came to cheer you on! But first... battle!
player_won: {friend_name}: You're amazing!

intro: Tierno: My team's grooving! Battle!
player_won: Tierno: You've got the best rhythm in Kalos!

intro: Trevor: I've been training too! Please, one battle!
player_won: Trevor: You're incredible.

lines: Shelves of notes on Mega Evolution line the lab's library.
One page reads: 'A Mega Stone and a Key Stone, joined by the bond between Trainer and Pokémon.'
Dexio: The Professor asked us to check on you.
Sina: A quick battle, so we can report back!

player_won: Sina: You and your Pokémon really get along!
Dexio: We'll tell the Professor.

lines: Owner: Merci! Here, a little something for your hard work.
puzzle_fail: Owner: Don't worry, come back and try again when it's less busy!

lines: Restaurant Le Wow serves battles with every course. Your first course: Waiter Gaston!

player_won: Gaston: Magnifique! Your next course awaits.

lines: Chef Pierre: Dessert is served... in battle!

player_won: Chef Pierre: A perfect meal! The house thanks you.

lines: Vendor: You're a natural! Take some of the stall's medicine, the same stuff we bake into the galettes.
puzzle_fail: Vendor: Don't worry, come back when the line's shorter!

lines: Groomer: What a lovely Furfrou! A quick trim, on the house.
Your Furfrou struts out with a fresh, fluffy cut. It looks very pleased with itself!
Boutiques line Magenta Plaza. The prices make your eyes water!
Paintings and suits of armour fill the museum's halls.
A plaque tells of a king, a war, and a weapon built 3,000 years ago...

intro: Evelyn: Five battles in a row: that's the Battle Institute test. Last one!
player_won: Evelyn: Top marks! Your name goes on the Institute's board.

lines: The waiters in red suits smile a little too widely...
An empty stone room. It is perfectly quiet.
A sign reads: 'Clear your mind, and your Pokémon will follow.'

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Kalos
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Sycamore invited you to Kalos to study Mega Evolution. Visit his lab in Lumiose City and receive your starter Pokémon!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bug Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Viola at Santalune City Gym — the first gym in Kalos!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cliff Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head to Cyllage City via Ambrette Town and challenge Grant the rock climber.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rumble Badge & Mega Ring
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Korrina at Shalour City holds the secret of Mega Evolution. Earn the Rumble Badge to unlock this power!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Plant Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ramos tends his garden gym at Coumarine City. Earn 3 badges to challenge him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Voltage Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Return to Lumiose City with 4 badges — Clemont's auto-lock gym is now accessible!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Fairy Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Valerie's ethereal Fairy-type gym awaits in Laverre City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Psychic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The stars guide you to Anistar City. Earn the Psychic Badge from Olympia.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Iceberg Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Reach Snowbelle City and defeat Wulfric — the final gym stands between you and Victory Road!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stop Team Flare
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Flare's plan to use the Ultimate Weapon threatens all life in Kalos! Infiltrate Geosenge HQ and stop Lysandre!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the Kalos League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With all 8 badges, traverse Victory Road and face the Elite Four. Champion Diantha awaits at the top!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Discover Mega Evolution
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Korrina at the Tower of Mastery will grant you the Mega Ring after you earn the Rumble Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Order Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep in Terminus Cave on Route 18, the legendary Zygarde monitors Kalos's ecosystem.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pokémon Village
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Lost Pokémon gather in this hidden village. Something powerful lurks here — and an ancient king's tale unfolds.
